XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
The vehicle's equipment includes a service interval indicator, integrated into the instrument display.
The indicator provides the driver with a series of warnings regarding scheduled maintenance operations to which the vehicle must be subjected periodically.

XCAPITOLO.Capitolo: Adjustment - Resetting the engine oil change indicator
XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Once the engine oil has been changed, the indicator is manually reset in the following ways:

  • disconnect the ignition
  • press and hold the button (1)
  • insert the ignition
  • the message that the indicator has reset will appear in the display. engine oil change
  • release the button (1)
  • press the button (1) to confirm

    The service interval indicator is now reset to zero.

XCAPITOLO.Capitolo: Adjustment - Resetting the service interval indicator
XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
After maintenance work has been carried out, the indicator is manually reset in the following ways:

  • disconnect the ignition
  • press and hold the button (1)
  • insert the ignition
  • the message that the indicator has reset will appear in the display. maintenance intervals
  • release the button (1)
  • press the button (1) to confirm

    The service interval indicator is now reset to zero.

Resetting long-term maintenance intervals to zero is only possible with the manufacturer's dedicated diagnostic equipment.

However, you can reset the extended maintenance intervals by following this procedure, but if you do so, the interval will change from extended to fixed maintenance.

Before zeroing, check that there are no fault codes in the memory and that all doors are closed.
